name: Wavefront Path Tracer with Spatial Hashing
definition: A path tracing method that uses spatial hashing to accumulate radiance, allowing for denoising via spatial filtering. It uses Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) to combine light source and BRDF samples.
summary: Wavefront Path Tracer with Spatial Hashing is a path tracing method that decouples the accumulation buffer from the pixel grid to enable spatial averaging of radiance estimates across hash buckets.
